description.value: The geomancer summons a luopan (a small orb that floats just above the ground that is a pylon of geomantic energies) within the spell range that has hit points equal to 10 x the geomancer’s level and a hardness equal to its spell level. This luopan emits the effect in the area of the luopan that affects specified targets. When the duration is over, the luopan is unsummoned. The affected allies become wiser within the selective area. They gain the benefit as long as they’re within the area of effect of the spell. The spell grants a +6 enhancement bonus to Wisdom, adding the usual benefit to Wisdom-related skills. White mages (and other Wisdom-based spellcasters) who receive Geo-Wis do not gain any additional bonus spells for the increased Wisdom, but the save DCs for their spells increase.
